response.rationale: The order status is "processing" and days_since_delivery is null, meaning the item has not yet been delivered. No standard-window rule (RET-007/RET-008) can evaluate true because they require a numeric days_since_delivery. RET-020 (defective) is false, RET-012 (final_sale) is false, RET-050 (goodwill) is false, and RET-051 (fraud_hold) is false. Since no rule's condition is satisfied on these facts—there is nothing yet delivered to return—the request cannot be approved as a return.
